question: I got so excited by the powerful scene where Momonosuke and Kaidou became dragons and squared off against each other!!! I wonder if this scene was modeled after the Twin Dragons painting at Kennin-ji Temple, which Odacchi had previously visited for an interview!?
answer: That's right. I went to Kyoto before entering Wano Country. I saw it in person, there were two huge dragons on the ceiling, the painting was very impactful. I thought to myself: "I definitely have to draw this".
name: Tsubocchi
